description: Stalls per row, rows, total stalls, painted stall line length and the minimum accessible spaces for a lot, using the stall sizes and drive aisle widths in Toronto Zoning By-law 569-2013 and the accessible count in Ontario Regulation 191/11. Every parameter is optional and has a default. Preliminary layout only. Other municipalities set their own stall sizes and aisle widths, and a site plan must meet the zoning by-law, fire route, drainage and accessibility rules that apply to the site. Confirm with your municipality.

angle.description: Stall angle to the drive aisle in degrees. 90 is perpendicular.

lot_depth.description: Depth of the paved area, measured across the rows of stalls. Unit: m or ft.

lot_width.description: Length of one row of stalls, measured along the drive aisle. Unit: m or ft.

stall_length.description: Stall length along the stall. The default is the 5.6 m minimum in By-law 569-2013 section 200.5.1.10(2). Unit: mm.

stall_width.description: Stall width across the stall. If left out, 2,600 mm is used with a 6.0 m aisle and 2,900 mm with a narrower aisle, as in section 200.5.1.10(2)(A) and (B). Unit: mm.

units.description: Units for the lot width and depth.
